## ICloseSuggestionPullRequestsInput.token property

GitHub personal access token (or user token) used to read pull requests and close eligible ones. Closing needs permission to update pull requests. Never included in an outcome or a rejection.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly token: string;
```
